objective: Reproducible small-scale prediction of chronological age from public cultured human fibroblast expression; not a rejuvenation or mechanism experiment.
eligibility: GEO characteristics disease=Normal and age>=18; one sample per public cell-line ID; all HGPS and pediatric samples excluded from primary analysis.
label_source: Authoritative GEO series-matrix characteristics, not age in expression-column title. Preserve reported metadata, including age 96.

split.algorithm: sklearn GroupShuffleSplit on samples sorted by GSM accession
split.inner_cv: GroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261021) on training only

features.selection: Training fold only: retain maximum FPKM>=5, log1p then highest variance up to 1000 transcripts, stable feature-index tie break
features.scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on training fold

evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired sample-resampling replicates, percentile 95% CI, seed 20261022
evaluation.negative_control: 30 training-label permutations of final selected Ridge alpha, independent seed20261023; fixed holdout unchanged; diagnostic, not a confirmatory permutation p-value

hypothesis: Gene expression predicts chronological age in held-out adult cell lines better than the training-median baseline.
acceptance: For each model separately: holdout MAE at least 20% lower than median baseline and 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound of baseline MAE minus model MAE >0; otherwise FAIL. MLP superiority over Ridge requires separately positive 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound, and is not assumed.
stop_conditions: Missing/unmapped samples or duplicate public cell IDs
Any use of holdout for model selection
limitations: Public cell IDs are only a donor proxy; donor provenance and kinship are not independently established
Age, sex, cell culture, passage, ancestry and sequencing batch can confound
Chronological age is not biological age or cell function
No intervention, mechanism, reversal, lifespan or clinical efficacy claim
approval: User authorized public-data local small-scale training and publishing code and honest results to xuda1979/anti-aging. No clinical or paid computing actions.
